episodes.synopsis: Rito tries to work up the courage to confess to his long time crush. The universe seems to be against him, dropping a naked runaway alien princess named Lala into his bathtub.
episodes.title: The Girl Who Fell From the Sky

episodes.synopsis: Rito finds that he's engaged to Lala and has three days to save the planet from her alien father, King Deviluke. To make matters worse, his longtime crush is mad at him.
episodes.title: A Broken Engagement?!

episodes.synopsis: Lala is the new transfer student at Rito's school and even though he implores her to keep a low profile, her antics are making her rather popular.
episodes.title: Love Triangle

episodes.synopsis: Inspired by Mikan's hot meals, Lala tries to cook, but the results are yucky. Rito sees his chance and declares that he will not marry Lala unless she can cook well for him.
episodes.title: A Love Apron from Outer Space

episodes.synopsis: Saki Tenhouin, the queen of Sainan High School, becomes jealous when she finds out Lala's popularity is on the rise and challenges her to the Miss Sainan Competition.
episodes.title: The Queen's Challenge

episodes.synopsis: Lala wants to learn more about Rito, but she may have gotten the wrong idea in science class during dissections.
episodes.title: The Alien Assassin

episodes.synopsis: A new rival for Lala's affections has arrived at Sainan Private High School: Ren, one of her childhood friends.
episodes.title: All Men Should Be Like This

episodes.synopsis: One of the school prefects, Yui, is all about good morality. She convinces the principal to allow her to create an enforcement squad, making Rito public enemy number one.
episodes.title: The Prefect of Spotless Integrity

episodes.synopsis: Another suitor blasts his way into the picture, this time quite literally, wearing an armored rocket suit, trying desperately to snatch Lala.
episodes.title: From A Shining Star, With Love

episodes.synopsis: The president of Lala's fanclub comes to take Lala away for an idol CD, but she refuses so she needs to find a 'golden egg' to do the acting. Rito tries to stop her when the president fixates on Haruna, saying that only Haruna could work as as substitute for Lala.
episodes.title: A Space Entertainer

episodes.synopsis: Rito is attacked by a strange, golden haired girl on the street. It turns out that she is an assassin, know as Golden Darkness, hired to kill him.
episodes.title: The Golden Darkness

episodes.synopsis: The athletic festival has arrived and Rito makes a complete fool of himself, trying everything he can think of to impress Haruna.
episodes.title: A Frightening Field Day!

episodes.synopsis: King Deviluke is coming to Earth to see if Rito is worthy. Rito is left with only one option: become the Greatest Man in the Universe.
episodes.title: The Greatest Man in the Universe

episodes.synopsis: With Rito's Greatest Man in the Universe training underway, he runs into Haruna and they develop an unlikely relationship, which finally escalates in Rito's favor: a date!
episodes.title: A Secret Between the Two of Us

episodes.synopsis: Rito, Haruna, and Lala are moving up in the universe, when an alien prince visits and they each become Ambassadors of Peace from the Earth.
episodes.title: Princess of the Jungle

episodes.synopsis: Everyone decides to have a fun afternoon together at the water park. However, Rito now has a new source of relationship drama: Run has fallen in love with him, too.
episodes.title: Run's Surprise Confession

episodes.synopsis: Rito and everyone decide to go to the old school to find out if the rumor of a ghost haunting the building is true.
episodes.title: The Ghost in the Old School Building

episodes.synopsis: A spaceship flies over the school and drops off a package for Lala on the roof. Inside the package is a pregnant wolf that jumps out and tries to kill her!
episodes.title: Saruyama, The Gift

episodes.synopsis: After seeing a commercial on TV promoting a hot springs, Lala tells Rito that she wants to own one, proceeding to build her own right in their backyard.
episodes.title: Hell's Hot Springs: Alien Girls and Colorful Exposed Bodies

episodes.synopsis: General Mojack decides to try and take over the world so Kirisaki takes it upon her self to destroy him by turning into Magical Kyoko Flame.
episodes.title: Explosive Heat Magical Girl Kyouko Flame

episodes.synopsis: Yuuki hears about an alien hotel being run by Mikade-sensei and Kimio. There, Yuuki decides to try it check it out via the old school building.
episodes.title: A Chronicle of Bloodshed at Yuuki Inn

episodes.synopsis: Everyone is upset by Yui's submission of what they should do for the culture festival. She submitted that they do a region research display or a calligraphy display.
episodes.title: A Frightening School Festival!

episodes.synopsis: Saruyama wishes that he was a nobleman from the Edo Castle. He then starts to daydream about being the ruler of Edo Castle.
episodes.title: Saruyama's Tales of the Inner Chambers

episodes.synopsis: Lala's personality changes due to a fever. Rito now has to deal with Lala's constantly changing personalitues and her desire to take over the world as a deviluke princess.
episodes.title: With Shyness

episodes.synopsis: Rito receives a message from the King which orders him to board the spaceship and prove he is the best in the universe. Before boarding, he confesses his feelings for Haruna.
episodes.title: Earth's Final Night

episodes.synopsis: Yuki wakes up to Haruna and Lala yelling at him that he is about to miss the ship. Lala decides she can't marry unless he wants to.
episodes.title: Lala
